metadata.name: image-crop-frame
metadata.description: Image fitted inside the element with a draggable crop window of a fixed ratio and a composition overlay; the crop is stored as a focus point (centre of the crop, 0–1), the same rule as imgproxy's gravity fp:x:y.
features: Image fitted inside the element without distortion (contain)
Crop window of any ratio ("4:5", "16:9", or a number)
Drag to move the crop, only along the axis the ratio leaves free
Arrow keys (Shift = 10%) once focused with Tab; a mouse drag does not take focus
Optional snap to the image centre while dragging, with a centre guide line
Composition overlays: rule of thirds, golden ratio (phi grid), grid, diagonals, golden triangle, golden spiral, center cross, none; triangle and spiral can be flipped
Loading spinner until the image has loaded
Emits change on release, not while dragging
Local context: focus, crop box, output size in px, trimmed side
Actions: center crop, set focus point
Does not resize (zoom) the crop: it is always the largest box of the ratio

properties.name: imageUrl
properties.description: URL of the image.

properties.name: alt
properties.description: Alt text of the image.

properties.name: ariaLabel
properties.description: Accessible name of the crop window. Empty = the element name, else "Crop area".

properties.name: imageWidth
properties.description: Width of the original in px. Empty = taken from the loaded image. Also used for the output size in the local context.

properties.name: imageHeight
properties.description: Height of the original in px. Empty = taken from the loaded image.

properties.name: ratio
properties.description: Crop ratio width:height, e.g. "4:5". Empty = 4:3.

properties.name: focusX
properties.description: Horizontal centre of the crop, 0–1. Empty = 0.5. While the user drags, and until this value changes, the component shows its own position.

properties.name: focusY
properties.description: Vertical centre of the crop, 0–1. Empty = 0.5.

properties.name: snapToCenter
properties.description: While dragging, snap the crop centre to the image centre when within snapDistance, and show a centre line (color: snapLineColor). Arrow keys and actions do not snap.

properties.name: snapDistance
properties.description: snapToCenter on: snap distance in screen px.

properties.name: darken
properties.description: 0–100: darkness of the area outside the crop.

properties.name: overlay
properties.description: Composition guide inside the crop window.

properties.name: gridDivisions
properties.description: overlay = grid: number of square cells along the short side (2–12).

properties.name: overlayFlipH
properties.description: overlay = triangle / spiral: mirror left–right.

properties.name: overlayFlipV
properties.description: overlay = triangle / spiral: mirror top–bottom.

properties.name: overlayOpacity
properties.description: 0–100: opacity of the guide lines.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Prevent the user from moving the crop (actions still work).

properties.name: frameColor
properties.description: Color of the crop border and focus ring. Style property (responsive, states, classes).

properties.name: overlayColor
properties.description: Color of the guide lines. Style property (responsive, states, classes).

properties.name: snapLineColor
properties.description: Color of the centre line shown while snapped (snapToCenter). Style property (responsive, states, classes).

properties.name: spinnerColor
properties.description: Color of the loading spinner. Style property (responsive, states, classes).

states.name: dragging
states.description: While the user drags the crop (root has data-dragging="true").

events.name: change
events.description: The crop moved: drag released, arrow keys stopped for 400 ms, double-click to centre, or an action. Save event.value there (in a js formula the event is `event`, not `context.event`).

value.x: number, new horizontal focus point (0–1, 4 decimals)
value.y: number, new vertical focus point (0–1, 4 decimals)

localContext.name: imageCropFrame
localContext.description: Live crop info: focus { x, y }; crop { focusX, focusY, left, top, width, height } (fractions); output { width, height } in px of the original (null while its size is unknown); trim { axis: 'width' | 'height' | null, percent }; ratio; isDragging; isLoaded.

actions.label: Center crop
actions.description: Moves the focus point to the centre and emits change.

actions.label: Set focus point
actions.description: Moves the focus point and emits change (nothing if unchanged). An empty or invalid coordinate keeps its current value; values are clamped to 0–1.

variables.name: value
variables.description: Current crop, live while dragging: { focusX, focusY, left, top, width, height }, all fractions of the image (0–1).

specifications: The element needs a height (and width): the image is fitted inside it, centred.
Crop box = largest box of `ratio` inside the image, as centred on (focusX, focusY) as the image allows. Moving only changes the free axis; the other keeps its stored value.

Bind focusX / focusY to the stored point and save on the change event; after a change the component keeps showing its own position until the bound values change, so an optimistic update avoids any jump.
Moving is disabled in the editor's edit mode (selection keeps working).
The golden spiral and triangle are stretched to the crop window, like in photo editors; flip them to match the subject.

examples.description: Portrait crop of a landscape photo, saved point, golden spiral
